notes.title: Thank you for awesome feedback!
notes.content:
STEAM FANS! We love you!! Thank you for giving us feedback on what we should develop next. We created a roadmap based on your feedback, and here are the new features COMING SOON to Odesi for free:


Arpeggiators
Audio import so you can work with an acapella
Comprehensive guide on how to make unique music without presets
Grooves and swing so drums don't sound too robotic
Humanization of MIDI input
Melody sketch generators
Better Mixer user interface - it's almost done, just need to launch it soon
Song structure - being able to create verse/chorus/break structure and rearrange the pieces quickly


If you guys have feedback, feel free to post on the Community Hub. Enjoy using Odesi and create some kickass music for your projects!
